check_olt_access_or_redirect(int $olt_id, string $redirect_to = '../dashboard.php'): redirects with session error if no access
check_olt_access_json(int $olt_id): emits JSON error and exits if no access
backend/config.php.notable_patterns: Encryption: AES-256-GCM primary with legacy AES-256-CBC fallback for decrypt (migration path). CSRF: session token + header/POST field, auto-enforced globally for any POST to '/action/' scripts, differentiates JSON vs redirect error response. RBAC gating: 3 roles (superadmin/admin/user) with OLT-group-based admin scoping. Security headers + CSP set unconditionally at top of file. engine_token() payload key order is intentionally alphabetical to match Python's json.dumps(sort_keys=True) for signature compatibility.

backend/cron_check_olt_status.php.purpose: Lightweight cron script (run every minute) that checks SSH and SNMP reachability for every OLT and writes a combined status ('Connected'/'SSH Only'/'SNMP Only'/'Disconnected'/'Error') plus last_health_check timestamp into the olts table.
backend/cron_check_olt_status.php.notable_patterns: Uses a flock()-based lock file (sys_get_temp_dir()) to prevent overlapping cron runs, with try/finally cleanup (unlink lock file). Does NOT run heavy show-running-config pulls, intentionally kept fast (SSH checkConnection + raw SNMP ping only).

backend/db.php.purpose: Establishes the global PDO MySQL connection ($pdo) from .env-configured credentials, runs a versioned idempotent schema-migration system (schema_migrations table, migrations 2-6) that creates/alters all core tables, and provides description-parsing helper functions for OLT structured descriptions.
key_functions: extract_customer_name(?string $desc): extracts customer name from structured OLT description string (name_XXX_zone_... pattern) or normalizes underscores to spaces as fallback
parse_structured_description(?string $desc): regex-parses OLT description into zone/address/splitter/contact/external_id fields
backend/db.php.notable_patterns: Self-contained forward-only migration runner gated by version number in schema_migrations, each migration wrapped in individual try/catch so partial failures (e.g. column already exists) don't abort the whole run; `static $_migrations_done` ensures migrations run once per process/request. On PDOException: CLI mode sets $pdo=null and continues (degraded mode), web mode renders a styled HTML error page and exits. ENUM columns are widened before data migration then narrowed again (3-step ALTER pattern) to avoid data loss during RBAC role rename.

backend/driver.php.notable_patterns: Driver resolution is tiered: exact match -> normalized match -> alias match; never silently falls back to a different vendor's driver (explicit safety comment: different CLI syntax could corrupt config). call_driver() has two transport paths: REST to FastAPI engine first, then raw Python CLI subprocess via exec() as fallback if REST unreachable, with HTTP 404 short-circuited as 'unsupported feature' (no need to try CLI). All OLT ops funnel through call_driver() uniformly as thin one-line wrapper functions. check_olt_connection() explicitly discards any 'SNMP Status' text claimed by the driver itself and recomputes it locally since no driver can be trusted to have actually tested SNMP (regression #238 guarded by test_snmp_status.php). No require_once for config.php/db.php — assumes caller already loaded them (relies on call_driver's use of decrypt_password/engine_token from config.php and globals).

backend/genieacs.php.notable_patterns: Security-critical comment at top: GenieACS NBI has NO built-in auth (CVE-2025-56015) so this file must never be exposed to the browser — all access server-side only, proxied through 127.0.0.1. Edit functions mostly send each field as a SEPARATE setParameterValues task (not batched) to avoid cpeFault 9003 'Invalid arguments' killing the whole batch when one field is unsupported by firmware — except genieacs_edit_generic_params which intentionally batches into ONE atomic task (opposite tradeoff, chosen to avoid silent per-field loop timeouts). Vendor divergence handled by sending redundant vendor-prefixed params (X_HW_*, X_FH_*, X_CT-COM_*) for the same logical field rather than branching logic, letting unsupported params be silently ignored by firmware. `ponytail:`-style comment documents a deliberate simplification (hardcoded WAN index 1.1 in genieacs_edit_ppp_params) with upgrade trigger noted. genieacs_find_wan_instance_anywhere() pattern of 'reuse existing instance, only addObject if truly absent' is reused by genieacs_push_wan to avoid duplicate WAN instances on repeated saves. Null return from genieacs_request() specifically distinguishes HTTP/cURL failure from a valid-but-empty success response.

backend/test_registry_meta.php.purpose: CLI self-check script asserting that get_olt_supported_panels() and get_olt_driver_info() work from static registry data alone, without ever loading any PHP driver file or the removed backend/drivers folder (regression guard for issue #234 driver-PHP removal).
key_functions: ok($cond, $label): simple assert-and-print-or-exit(1) helper used throughout the script
backend/test_registry_meta.php.notable_patterns: Assert-based self-check script (no test framework) matching the 'ONE runnable check' convention; checks get_included_files() to prove no file under '/drivers/' was ever loaded, and confirms get_driver_instance() no longer exists. Run via `php backend/test_registry_meta.php`.

backend/test_snmp_status.php.purpose: CLI self-check script verifying check_olt_connection() determines SNMP status from an actual check_snmp_ping() test rather than trusting/parsing the Python driver's fake 'SNMP Status' claim text (regression guard for issue #238, cross-checked against frontend/action/get-olt-health.php's expected string and the python_engine driver files).
key_functions: cek(string $label, bool $ok): void: assert helper incrementing global $fail counter and printing failures
backend/test_snmp_status.php.notable_patterns: Source-inspection style testing: uses file_get_contents + preg_match on driver.php's own source code to assert it calls check_snmp_ping() and strips SNMP claims via preg_replace, rather than only testing behavior — a whitebox static-analysis-as-test pattern. Also scans every backend/python_engine/drivers/*.py file's text to assert none of them emit 'SNMP Status' themselves. Exits with non-zero status ($fail count) on any failure for CI/cron-friendly use.

backend/vlan_cache.php.purpose: Refreshes an OLT's VLAN list by reading live data from the device (via driver.php) and upserting it into the olt_vlans DB cache table, while preserving locally-set 'type' (management/common) metadata that OLTs never report themselves; also provides a setter for that metadata.
key_functions: refresh_olt_vlans(array $olt): array: fetches live VLANs via get_olt_vlans(), normalizes mixed object/plain-int VLAN entries, preserves existing 'type' per vlan_id from DB, upserts into olt_vlans inside a transaction, then deletes stale VLANs no longer present on device; returns normalized VLAN list
set_olt_vlan_management(int $olt_id, int $vlan_id, bool $is_management): bool: toggles a VLAN's 'type' column between 'management'/'common'
backend/vlan_cache.php.notable_patterns: Read-before-write pattern to prevent device refresh from clobbering software-only metadata ('type' column intentionally excluded from the ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE clause). Wraps upsert+delete-stale in a PDO transaction (beginTransaction/commit) for atomicity. Upsert is 'race-proof' via unique key (olt_id, vlan_id) per inline comment. Delete-stale uses dynamic placeholder count based on $vlan_ids, with separate SQL branch when the list is empty (DELETE all for that olt_id).

backend/vpn_status_sync.php.purpose: Script (likely cron) that parses the OpenVPN status log (/var/log/openvpn/openvpn-status.log) for currently connected clients and syncs connection state (status/client_ip/tunnel_ip) into the vpn_tunnels DB table, matching by certificate common name (CN).
backend/vpn_status_sync.php.notable_patterns: No function definitions — straight-line procedural script. Silently exits(0) if the OpenVPN status log is unreadable (@file_get_contents suppressed). Only downgrades a tunnel to 'disconnected' if it isn't already (`AND status != 'disconnected'`), avoiding redundant writes/churn on unchanged rows.

frontend/action/onu-set-mgmt-ip.php.purpose: Sets or clears an ONU's TR-069/management IP (Inactive/DHCP/Static mode, VLAN, IP, WAN remote access) by pushing config to the OLT and saving the result to DB.

frontend/action/onu-set-tr609.php.purpose: Assigns or removes a TR-069 ACS profile on an ONU, computing management/internet VLAN and pushing TR-069 server params to the OLT via driver, then persisting profile name/vlan_mode to DB.
key_functions: Main logic: resolve tr069_profiles row (default or named), compute mgmt_vlan/mgmt_priority/internet_vlan, call_driver(olt, 'set_tr069_profile', ...), update onus table

frontend/action/port-config.php.notable_patterns: can_access_settings() gate (superadmin-only settings action); verify_csrf_token(); check_olt_access_or_redirect(); session_write_close() before CLI call; redacts OLT password from response message; write_audit_log().

frontend/action/reboot-onu.php.purpose: Sends a reboot command to an ONU via the OLT driver (form POST, redirect-based), marks it offline in DB, and writes an audit log.
key_functions: Main logic: fetch ONU+OLT row, check_olt_access_or_redirect(), session_write_close()/reboot_onu($olt,$onu)/session_start(), update onus.status, write_audit_log()
frontend/action/reboot-onu.php.notable_patterns: Session-based form handler; verify_csrf_token(); set_time_limit(0) for long SSH calls; debug_mode session log capture.

frontend/action/register.php.notable_patterns: Session fixation protection via session_regenerate_id(true) on initial setup; verify_csrf_token(); can_access_settings() gate for non-initial registrations; catches PDOException 1062 (duplicate username).

frontend/action/replace-onu.php.notable_patterns: Session-based form handler; verify_csrf_token(); check_olt_access_or_redirect(); set_time_limit(0) for multi-step SSH round-trips; best-effort rollback re-authorize of old SN if new authorize fails; write_audit_log().

key_functions: Main logic: fetch ONU+OLT row, check_olt_access_or_redirect(), session_write_close()/restore_factory_onu($olt,$onu)/session_start(), update onus.status, write_audit_log()
frontend/action/restore-factory.php.notable_patterns: Session-based form handler; verify_csrf_token(); set_time_limit(0); debug_mode session log capture; nearly identical structure to reboot-onu.php.

key_functions: Main logic: validate olt_id/access, build shell_exec command to python_engine/sync_snmp_onus.py, check output for 'Done.' to determine success
frontend/action/snmp-sync.php.notable_patterns: Calls Python engine via shell_exec (not FastAPI HTTP); has_olt_access() check for specific OLT id; session_write_close() before long-running shell_exec; set_time_limit(300).

frontend/action/speed-profiles.php.notable_patterns: can_access_settings() gate for non-list actions; verify_csrf_token() for non-list actions; check_olt_access_or_redirect(); transactional DB rewrite on sync; confirm-before-delete UX pattern (needs_confirm flag) when profile in use; write_audit_log(); catches Throwable with pdo rollback.

key_functions: Main logic: check_snmp_ping() preflight, pull_configured_onus(), INSERT...ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE onus in transaction, delete stale rows older than grace_cutoff not in active_onu_keys, launch cron_sync.py --force-config via popen/exec in background, write_audit_log()

frontend/configured.php.purpose: Daftar ONU yang sudah terkonfigurasi (customer list) dengan filter multi-kriteria, pagination, live-polling status, dan export CSV.
key_functions: Filter parsing: search, olt_id[] (multi-select array), status, zone, odb[] (multi-select array, includes 'None'), pon_port, signal, onu_type, vlan, profile
SQL filter build: $filter_sql + $params, olt_id/odb pakai IN (...) dengan placeholder dinamis

Datalist/count queries: $olts, $olt_counts, $available_zones, $available_odbs, $odb_counts, $available_pon_ports, $available_onu_types, $available_vlans, $available_profiles -- semua di-scope ke $olt_filter_in
Live poller (JS setInterval): fetch ke action/onu-data.php? untuk update status/sinyal tanpa reload
CSV export link: action/export-csv.php? dengan semua filter saat ini diteruskan via http_build_query
frontend/configured.php.notable_patterns: Filter lama pakai pola input type=text + <datalist> (searchable, auto-submit onchange). Filter OLT & ODB/Splitter sudah diupgrade jadi custom multi-select dropdown: class .ms-dropdown (tombol ringkasan + panel search+checkbox+counter+tombol Terapkan), vanilla JS toggle via classList, checked state dari $_GET array. $selected_olt_id (scalar) tetap dipertahankan sebagai turunan dari $selected_olts (array) HANYA kalau persis 1 OLT dipilih -- jangan dipakai untuk cek 'ada OLT dipilih', pakai !empty($selected_olts). $olt_filter_in = comma-separated ID untuk SQL IN clause, fallback ke $allowed_ids_str kalau kosong. Tabel pakai table-layout:fixed + overflow-wrap:anywhere di semua th/td supaya teks panjang wrap bukan melebar. Kolom WAN & Tipe ONU sudah dihapus, diganti Nama ODP (dari $onu['splitter']) + Zone.

shared_conventions: Hampir semua halaman frontend (kecuali login.php, register.php, index.php) require backend/db.php lalu frontend/header.php di awal, dan frontend/footer.php di akhir.

Akses OLT per-user dikontrol via has_olt_access($olt_id) dan get_allowed_olt_ids()/get_allowed_olts() di backend/config.php -- WAJIB dipanggil sebelum query/aksi yang menyentuh data OLT tertentu, supaya non-superadmin tidak bisa akses OLT di luar assignment-nya.
Semua endpoint POST di frontend/action/*.php WAJIB verify_csrf_token() (ditegakkan juga secara global di backend/config.php untuk request POST ke /action/).

Password OLT disimpan terenkripsi (encrypt_password()/decrypt_password() di backend/config.php, AES-256-GCM dengan fallback baca legacy AES-256-CBC). JANGAN simpan/transmit password OLT plaintext ke DB.

String yang diselipkan ke perintah CLI OLT (SSH/Telnet) WAJIB disaring via cli_safe()/cli_safe_strict()/cli_safe_password()/cli_safe_email() di backend/config.php untuk cegah command injection -- jangan interpolate user input mentah ke command string.

Semua pemanggilan ke driver OLT (ambil status, config VLAN, dsb) didelegasikan ke backend/driver.php (dispatcher per-vendor: ZTE C300/C320, CDATA FD1602SB1, dst) -- JANGAN build command CLI vendor-spesifik langsung di file frontend/action/*.php.

Filter pencarian di halaman list (configured.php, unconfigured.php) pakai pola input type=text + <datalist> (bukan <select>) supaya user bisa ketik sekaligus pilih dari daftar -- auto-submit via onchange="this.form.submit()". Perkecualian: filter OLT & ODB/Splitter di configured.php sudah di-upgrade ke custom multi-select checkbox dropdown (class .ms-dropdown), karena butuh pilih lebih dari satu nilai sekaligus.

Nama pelanggan yang tersimpan di DB kadang pakai underscore sebagai pengganti spasi (artefak input lama) -- JANGAN diubah di DB, normalisasi HANYA saat tampil pakai extract_customer_name()/fungsi display_name sejenis di backend/db.php. Field zone/alamat/ODP TIDAK ikut dinormalisasi ini.

Tabel data besar (onu list dsb) pakai class .data-table dengan table-layout:fixed + overflow-wrap:anywhere pada th/td supaya teks panjang (nama, alamat, splitter) wrap ke bawah, bukan melebarkan kolom.

Live-polling status ONU/OLT pakai JS fetch() periodik ke endpoint action/*.php (onu-data.php, get-olt-health.php) tanpa reload halaman -- halaman awal selalu render cepat dari data DB dulu, data live menyusul async.

TR-069 read/write ke device lewat GenieACS NBI didelegasikan ke backend/genieacs.php, dipanggil dari frontend/action/genieacs-proxy.php dan action/tr069-action.php -- JANGAN panggil GenieACS API langsung dari file frontend/*.php di luar action/.
Reset link filter pada halaman list cukup link ke halaman itu sendiri tanpa query string (bukan daftar ulang semua param kosong satu-satu).

Olt_id dan field multi-select lain dikirim sebagai array via nama input name="xxx[]"; backend menerima dengan isset($_GET['xxx']) lalu is_array() check, fallback ke single value jika bukan array (back-compat).

git workflow repo ini: workspace lokal TIDAK punya folder .git -- perubahan di-copy ke clone sementara ($env:TEMP\smartolt-push) untuk commit & push ke https://github.com/erlanggaalfian/smartolt.git. Jangan asumsikan 'git status' di workspace lokal akan menunjukkan apa pun.

db_schema_notes.onus: Tabel utama data ONU (customer). Kolom penting: olt_id (FK ke olts), serial_number, name (nama pelanggan, kadang underscore->spasi butuh extract_customer_name()), status (online/offline/disabled), pon_port (format gabungan slot/board+port, contoh '1/4/10:12' -- JANGAN parse manual jadi board/port terpisah tanpa verifikasi ulang format asli di DB, pernah dicek dan berisiko salah match), zone, splitter (nama ODP/ODB, 'None' atau NULL/'' berarti belum diisi), odb_port, vlan, download_profile/upload_profile (nama speed profile, relasi ke speed_profiles), onu_type, wan_mode, onu_mode, config_method, config_preset, pppoe_username/pppoe_password, mgmt_ip, pppoe_ip, last_rx_power/last_rx_olt_power (dBm, dipakai untuk kategori sinyal: critical < -30, weak -30..-28, fair -28..-25, good >= -25), last_down_cause, address/contact/external_id/description, latitude/longitude, updated_at.
db_schema_notes.olts: Daftar perangkat OLT. Kolom: name, ip, protocol (ssh/telnet), credentials (username/password terenkripsi), snmp community (random generated saat add-olt), brand/type (dipetakan ke driver di backend/driver.php).
db_schema_notes.onu_history: Histori time-series per ONU: rx_power, rx_olt_power, rx/tx bytes (dipakai hitung Mbps) -- sumber data chart Chart.js di onu-detail.php.
db_schema_notes.speed_profiles: Daftar paket kecepatan (download/upload) yang bisa dipasang ke ONU.
db_schema_notes.onu_types: Metadata tipe/model ONU: jumlah port ethernet, jumlah SSID WiFi, kapabilitas VoIP/CATV.
db_schema_notes.onu_presets: Preset konfigurasi ONU yang bisa dipilih cepat.
db_schema_notes.splitters: Daftar ODP/splitter per zone, dipakai sebagai sumber datalist/dropdown ODB di configured.php & onu-detail.php.
db_schema_notes.olt_vlans: Cache VLAN per OLT (cache-first read di action/vlan.php, refresh via refresh_olt_vlans() kalau cache miss).
db_schema_notes.user_olts: Mapping user ke OLT yang boleh diakses (dasar has_olt_access()/get_allowed_olt_ids()).
db_schema_notes.logs: Audit log aksi (write_audit_log() di backend/config.php): olt_id, action, message, timestamp.
